newsitem.title: UK: Physical Brent murky after deals 12 cents apart.
newsitem.headline: Physical Brent murky after deals 12 cents apart.

text.p: Dated Brent was steady to a shade weaker in a murky market on Thursday after traders reported deals 12 cents apart.
A Brent cargo due to load May 14-16 was sold for June Brent less 25 cents by a major European oil company to a U.S. refiner seeking to fill a VLCC for a trip to the U.S. Gulf.
The same buyer paid June Brent less 27 cents on Wednesday for a May 8-10 cargo, traders said.
The second cargo, due to load May 12-14, was sold by another major to a trader for June Brent less 37 cents.
June Brent shed seven cents to $18.45 a barrel by 1032 GMT.
Intermonth paper spreads were broadly unchanged from late U.S. levels, May/June talked at -20/-17 cents and June/July at -14/-11 cents. June/July traded at -13 and -12 cents in New York last night.
Brent Contracts for Difference edged lower, the May 5-9 period trading twice at June Brent -33 cents, about five cents weaker than late Wednesday's levels.
May 12-16 was talked at June Brent -33/-30 cents, down from June Brent -30/-24 cents.
Only one Brent cargo was due to be nominated May 16-18 loading dates on Thursday, traders said.
Other North Sea spot markets were quiet as holidays in most European countries depressed activity, they said.
"I don't think we'll see much happening over the next couple of days," said one.
